shared.title: Two Shadows
shared.body: Masser and Secunda lay two shadows across the road. Neither shadow asks this one to stand still.

shared.title: The Lattice Overhead
shared.body: The moons cross their appointed paths. The lattice is not a cage, but a way to know where each step begins.

shared.title: Silver on Dust
shared.body: Moonlight settles on dust, stone, and fur alike. Even the smallest road belongs beneath the same sky.

shared.title: The Night Has Measure
shared.body: The night is wide, but not without measure. The moons keep their places while mortals choose how to walk beneath them.

shared.title: Between the Moons
shared.body: There is room between the moons for doubt, delight, and another honest beginning.

shared.title: The Road Remembers
shared.body: The road remembers no single pawprint forever. It remembers that someone passed beneath the moons and kept going.

khenarthi.title: The Road Breathes
khenarthi.body: Khenarthi moves through grass and whiskers. The road ahead seems to breathe with this one's own chest.

khenarthi.title: A Windward Home
khenarthi.body: A warm wind carries scents from far camps. Khenarthi teaches that home may travel without becoming less true.

khenarthi.title: The Open Mile
khenarthi.body: No wall closes the next mile. Under Khenarthi's strength, distance feels less like exile and more like invitation.

khenarthi.title: Breath Between Steps
khenarthi.body: Khenarthi is present in the breath between one step and the next, the small freedom from which every journey grows.

khenarthi.title: The Scent of Rain
khenarthi.body: Rain has not yet fallen, but Khenarthi sends its scent ahead. The sky keeps promises in its own time.

khenarthi.title: Canvas Stirs
khenarthi.body: A tent wall stirs though the camp is quiet. Khenarthi reminds this one that shelter and open sky need not be enemies.

khenarthi.title: A Feather on the Road
khenarthi.body: A loose feather turns without choosing a destination. Khenarthi makes wandering look less like being lost.

khenarthi.title: The Far Caravan
khenarthi.body: A distant bell reaches farther than the caravan that carries it. Khenarthi joins separated travelers with one moving air.

khenarthi.title: The Unbarred Sky
khenarthi.body: No lock can be set upon the sky. Khenarthi's freedom is not escape alone, but the courage to depart well.

khenarthi.title: The Last Breeze
khenarthi.body: The breeze fades, yet leaves the fur changed by its passing. Khenarthi's gifts are often known by what continues after.

azurah.title: Twilight's Mirror
azurah.body: Azurah holds the sky between day and night. In that mirror, this one sees change without mistaking it for loss.

azurah.title: A Name at Dusk
azurah.body: At dusk the world keeps its shape while every color changes. Azurah knows the true name that survives both.

azurah.title: Shadow With Shape
azurah.body: Azurah's shadow is not emptiness. It gives bright things an edge and hidden things a form.

azurah.title: The Liminal Hour
azurah.body: The hour belongs wholly to neither sun nor stars. Azurah makes a sacred country of the threshold.

azurah.title: Rose and Indigo
azurah.body: Rose fades into indigo without a seam. Azurah teaches that transformation need not divide the self.

azurah.title: The First Star
azurah.body: One star appears before the others dare. Under Azurah's strength, revelation begins as a single point of light.

azurah.title: The Last Light
azurah.body: The last light does not resist the night. Azurah gives endings the dignity of becoming.

azurah.title: The Hidden Color
azurah.body: Moonlight draws a color from stone that daylight overlooked. Azurah's mysteries reveal; they do not merely conceal.

azurah.title: The Dusk-Bright Road
azurah.body: The road is clearest where day and night meet. Azurah marks the turn before this one knows it was sought.

azurah.title: Moons in Water
azurah.body: The moons tremble in dark water without breaking. Azurah shows how an image may move and remain true.

baandar.title: The Unlatched Gate
baandar.body: Baan Dar leaves one gate unlatched and lets pride guard the wrong door. Cleverness begins where certainty grows lazy.

baandar.title: Luck Turned Sideways
baandar.body: A poor throw lands well after striking the table's edge. Baan Dar rarely sends luck by the straight road.

baandar.title: The Laughing Escape
baandar.body: The trap closes on an empty cloak. Somewhere beyond it, Baan Dar is already laughing.

baandar.title: Clever Hands, Clear Debt
baandar.body: Baan Dar favors the hand that escapes cleanly, not the hand that leaves another pariah to pay its debt.

baandar.title: The Bent Rule
baandar.body: A rigid rule snaps; a clever one bends. Baan Dar tests which kind stands between this one and the road.

baandar.title: The Empty Purse
baandar.body: An empty purse can hide a full plan. Baan Dar counts resources that jailers and taxmen cannot see.

baandar.title: The Third Way
baandar.body: Two guards watch two exits. Baan Dar points to the roof and calls the argument settled.

baandar.title: The Pariah's Share
baandar.body: The feast denies a place, so Baan Dar makes a table from the road and leaves room for one more exile.

baandar.title: The Grinning Moon
baandar.body: The moon resembles a grin no magistrate can confiscate. Baan Dar's strength makes authority feel briefly smaller.

baandar.title: The Soft Fall
baandar.body: A misstep finds loose sand instead of stone. Baan Dar sometimes answers courage by moving the consequence.

rajhin.title: A Secret Kept
rajhin.body: Rajhin weighs a secret by the grace with which it is carried, not by the noise made in taking it.

rajhin.title: The Audacious Step
rajhin.body: The impossible step becomes merely difficult once Rajhin has placed one paw beyond the warning line.

rajhin.title: Limits in Silver
rajhin.body: Silver light outlines every lock and ledge. Rajhin sees limits clearly because he intends to cross them beautifully.

rajhin.title: The Purring Question
rajhin.body: A closed chest asks a question in metal and wood. Rajhin answers with patience, nerve, and a very small click.

rajhin.title: The Shadow of a Key
rajhin.body: A key casts a longer shadow than its teeth deserve. Rajhin knows possession is not the same as mastery.

rajhin.title: The Silent Bell
rajhin.body: A bell can be passed without ringing when every movement has purpose. Rajhin makes precision into its own boast.

rajhin.title: The Empty Pedestal
rajhin.body: Moonlight rests on an empty pedestal. Rajhin leaves absence arranged as carefully as another thief leaves loot.

rajhin.title: The Velvet Paw
rajhin.body: Softness is not hesitation. Rajhin's velvet paw reaches exactly where a mailed hand cannot.

rajhin.title: One Open Window
rajhin.body: A palace closes a hundred doors and forgets one high window. Rajhin calls that forgetfulness an invitation.

rajhin.title: The Moonlit Dare
rajhin.body: The wall looks taller in moonlight, and therefore more worth climbing. Rajhin's strength sharpens appetite into art.

alkosh.title: The Ordered Sky
alkosh.body: Alkosh sets the moons in sequence without hurrying them. Order is strongest when it does not need to shout.

alkosh.title: Scale and Second
alkosh.body: A heartbeat passes, then another. Alkosh makes time felt as a procession, not a prison.

alkosh.title: A Word With Weight
alkosh.body: Some words vanish into air; others change the shape of an age. Alkosh teaches the burden carried by the second kind.

alkosh.title: The Patience of Stone
alkosh.body: Stone waits through seasons without forgetting its place. Alkosh's strength can be still without becoming idle.

alkosh.title: The Turning Hour
alkosh.body: The hour turns exactly once and cannot be stolen back. Alkosh asks what deserves a place in it.

alkosh.title: The Dragon's Measure
alkosh.body: The sky is vast, yet Alkosh gives each flight a before and an after. Even dragons move within consequence.

alkosh.title: The Unbroken Line
alkosh.body: Moonlight draws one line along an old wall. Alkosh joins what came before to what must follow.

alkosh.title: Breath and Word
alkosh.body: Breath becomes a word, and a word becomes force. Alkosh reminds this one that power begins with form.

alkosh.title: The Rightful Moment
alkosh.body: Not every open path should be taken at once. Alkosh's strength makes restraint feel like readiness.

alkosh.title: A Clock Without Hands
alkosh.body: The moons keep time without gears or hands. Alkosh's order is written across distances no mortal could measure.
